title: Driggs Residents Invited to Comment on Proposed Downtown Hotel at December 10 Public Hearing - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago The Driggs Planning & Zoning Commission will hold a public hearing on Wednesday, December 10, 2025, at 6:00 p.m. The meeting will be at Driggs City Hall, 60 S. Main St., and available online via Zoom. The public can comment on the proposed development and other agenda items. Information on how to join the meeting and the full agenda is on the city’s website and at City Hall.
A main agenda item is a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-1) for the Alpine Range Hotel. The proposal is for a four-story hotel with more than 60 guest rooms. The hotel would be built on about 1.36 acres at the southwest corner of South Main Street and East Short Street in downtown Driggs. The site includes five parcels zoned for Downtown Mixed Use. Plans include a shopfront-style building, a ground-floor restaurant, retail space, and 76 parking spaces.
Guest rooms are planned for the upper three floors. The fourth floor would have a rooftop terrace. The proposal also includes landscaping and sidewalk changes. Application materials and site plans are available on the city’s website.
The review process for this hotel, which is a conditional use in the DX zoning district, follows the city’s Land Development Code. The Planning & Zoning Commission will review the project using the code’s criteria. They will consider possible effects on the community and nearby properties. The Commission may ask for more studies on social, economic, or environmental impacts before making a decision.
The public can submit written comments by 5 p.m. on December 1, 2025, for inclusion in the staff report. Verbal comments can be made at the hearing, in person or via Zoom. For more information or to request accommodations, residents can contact the Planning & Building Department by phone or email. Notification materials are available in accessible formats and in Spanish upon request.
